title: feat(toolbar): add insertTable helper and table-picker grid UI
body: ## Summary / 摘要 Add an `insertTable()` formatting helper and a Notion-style table-picker grid UI to the toolbar plugin, enabling users to insert GFM tables with a single click or via the `/table` slash command. ## Motivation / 背景与动机 The toolbar supports inserting images, code blocks, and horizontal rules, but lacks table insertion — a common Markdown editing operation. GFM tables are already supported by `preset-gfm` and the live-preview pipeline, so only the insertion UI was missing. - Issue: N/A - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #12 (Advanced toolbar — table tools) - OpenSpec change: N/A — extends existing toolbar pattern without new capability or API change ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/plugin-toolbar`: - `formatting.ts`: Added `insertTable(editor, rows?, cols?)` — inserts a GFM table at cursor position with automatic leading-newline handling, places cursor in first header cell - `icons.ts`: Added `iconTable()` SVG icon - `toolbar-ui.ts`: Added `showTablePicker()` — an 8×6 grid picker with hover-based highlighting and "N × M table" dimension label, wired into the dropdown click handler and `defaultGroups` - `index.ts`: Exported `insertTable`, registered `/table` slash command ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes — 547 tests (10 new for insertTable) - [x] `pnpm build` succeeds for all affected packages - [x] New vitest cases cover: - Default 3×3 table insertion with correct cursor placement - Leading-newline boundary (mid-line, after newline, document start) - Custom row/col counts, minimum 1 body row guarantee - Slash command integration - Toolbar button renders with accessible tooltip - [x] Manual verification in electron-demo ## Compliance / 合规自检 - [x] **CLA signed** — will sign when CLA bot prompts - [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is not primarily generated by AI. AI assistance limited to tab-completion and test scaffolding. - [x] **New dependencies**: None - [x] **No build artifacts** committed - [x] **No secrets** committed ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits - [x] N/A — no public API changes (extends existing toolbar pattern) - [x] N/A — `live-preview-table.ts` not touched - [x] N/A — no new capability or breaking change - [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) ## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 the table-picker grid follows the same UX pattern as the existing color-picker dropdowns.

commits_at_first_review.message: feat(toolbar): add insertTable helper and table-picker grid UI
